description: ACCDB: Simultaneous DAO Database + ADO Connection admission matrix in one process: (1) DAO RW + ADO RW writing different tables (T vs T2); (2) DAO RO + ADO RW (ADO writes T2, DAO reads); (3) ADO RO (adModeRead) + DAO RW (DAO writes T, ADO reads); (4) DAO Exclusive + ADO Shared RW (error); (5) ADO Exclusive (adModeShareExclusive=12) + DAO Shared RW and DAO Shared RO (errors). Keeps all pages before/after writes and close.

Keeps all pages before/after writes and close.
